dedupe_keys.name: yearly scenario data on electricity and district heating for current and ambitious policy scenario

description: Yearly scenario data on electricity and district heating for current and ambitious policy scenario is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Gustav Resch (TU Wien). The repository contains yearly scenario data on total conversion efficiencies for a current and ambitious policy scenario for electricity and district heating on nuts0 level. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2018. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
